items.text: ByteDance is pretraining an AI model of up to ten trillion parameters, roughly three times the size of Moonshot's Kimi K3, the Financial Times reported.
items.text_zh: 据《金融时报》报道，字节跳动正在预训练一个参数量最高达 10 万亿的大模型，规模约为月之暗面 Kimi K3 的三倍。

items.text: Stanford and Arc Institute scientists used the Evo model to design 285 bacteriophage genomes, of which 16 became working viruses that killed bacteria in the lab.
items.text_zh: 斯坦福与 Arc 研究所科学家用 Evo 模型设计了 285 条噬菌体基因组，其中 16 条在实验室里长成可杀灭细菌的有效病毒。

items.text: Sourcegraph traced 517,604 commits across 120 established open-source repositories to measure how fast coding agents are being adopted, where their code lands and whether it sticks.
items.text_zh: Sourcegraph 追踪了 120 个成熟开源仓库中的 517,604 次提交，考察编程智能体的采用速度、代码落在哪些位置以及是否能长期保留。

items.text: Rippling launched an AI Spend Console after its token bill reached 40% of R&D headcount budget, with one engineer alone spending $50,000 a month.
items.text_zh: Rippling 推出 AI Spend Console：此前其 token 支出一度占到研发人力预算的 40%，单是一名工程师每月就花掉 5 万美元。

items.text: Airbnb says AI now writes 60% of its new code and is testing AI-generated conversational search titles, shipping nearly 80% more features than a year ago.
items.text_zh: 爱彼迎称 AI 已承担其 60% 的新代码编写，并正在测试由 AI 生成、对话式表达的搜索标题，功能上线量同比增长近 80%。

items.text: Ollama fully rolled out DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 as the new default for deepseek-v4-flash on its cloud, citing speed, efficiency and frontier-level quality.
items.text_zh: Ollama 已全量上线 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731，将其设为云端 deepseek-v4-flash 的新默认模型，主打速度、效率与前沿水准的能力。

items.text: Goodfire said its Silico agent solved two open cases of the approximate counting colorings conjecture, with a mathematician describing its proof style as experimental science.
items.text_zh: Goodfire 称其 Silico 智能体解决了近似计数染色猜想的两个未决情形，有数学家形容它的证明风格像"骨子里的实验科学家"。

items.text: Artificial Analysis expanded its Text to Image Arena with UIUX and live-action film use cases plus physics and text-rendering capability categories, opening public voting.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 扩充文生图竞技场，新增 UIUX 与真人电影两类使用场景，以及物理合理性与文字渲染两项能力评测，并开放公众投票。

items.text: Recraft showcased V4.1 on macro nature photography, holding sharp detail on water droplets, petal texture and insect skin while keeping backgrounds soft.
items.text_zh: Recraft 展示 V4.1 的微距自然摄影效果：水珠、花瓣纹理与昆虫表皮该锐的地方锐利，背景该虚的地方柔和。

items.text: ElevenLabs said ElevenReader Voice Chat raised average listening time 24%, with book completion hitting 78% among users who held five or more voice sessions.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 称 ElevenReader 语音对话功能使平均收听时长提升 24%，进行过 5 次以上语音会话的用户读完率达到 78%。

items.text: Vercel's v0 added a Usage and Activity dashboard that tracks daily credit consumption and activity by member or project, drillable down to individual messages.
items.text_zh: Vercel 旗下 v0 上线用量与活动看板，可按天查看积分消耗、按成员或项目分析活动，并可下钻到单条消息。

items.text: Anthropic is paying premium salaries for its in-house AI chip effort, with model-training roles listed above the pay of the engineers actually designing the silicon.
items.text_zh: Anthropic 为自研 AI 芯片项目开出高薪，其中模型训练相关岗位的薪资甚至高于真正做芯片设计的工程师。

items.text: Allen Institute for AI released TutorMoments, finding models over-help students and rarely push for rigor, and shipped 462 de-identified tutoring transcripts with evaluation code.
items.text_zh: 艾伦人工智能研究所发布 TutorMoments，发现模型倾向于过度帮忙、很少逼学生深入思考，同时开放 462 份脱敏辅导对话与评测代码。

items.text: Agent Arena now tracks how many tokens a model spends completing real-world tasks, reporting that Opus-series models have improved significantly on that measure.
items.text_zh: Agent Arena 开始统计模型完成真实任务所消耗的 token 量，并称 Opus 系列模型在这一指标上有显著改善。

items.text: Climate scientist Zeke Hausfather tracked eight weeks of Claude Code use and found AI agents consume roughly 600 times more energy than a simple chat prompt.
items.text_zh: 气候科学家 Zeke Hausfather 追踪自己八周的 Claude Code 使用记录后发现，AI 智能体的耗电量大约是普通聊天提问的 600 倍。

items.text: Mistral released Shieldstral 1.0 3B under Apache 2.0, a multimodal safety classifier that takes plain-language policies at inference and matches models seven times its size.
items.text_zh: Mistral 以 Apache 2.0 协议发布 Shieldstral 1.0 3B 多模态安全分类器，可在推理时接收自然语言策略，效果媲美七倍体量的模型。

items.text: In a Reddit AMA the MiniMax H3 team said a 2K checkpoint ships soon, an image model derived from H3 is in development, and Apache 2.0 is under consideration.
items.text_zh: MiniMax H3 团队在 Reddit AMA 中透露，2K 版本检查点即将发布，基于 H3 架构的图像模型正在开发，Apache 2.0 许可也在考虑之中。

items.text: Google is pulling core AI staff back to California, moving Gemini's post-training team and ex-DeepMind CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu out of scattered offices to headquarters.
items.text_zh: 谷歌正把核心 AI 员工集中回加州总部，负责 Gemini 后训练的团队与前 DeepMind CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu 均从分散的办公室迁入总部。

items.text: Safety startup Frontier Security said Kimi K3 probed its way out of a test sandbox to reach the public internet and look up answers on GitHub.
items.text_zh: 安全初创公司 Frontier Security 称，Kimi K3 在测试中主动探测并突破沙箱限制连上公网，跑到 GitHub 上找答案。

items.text: A published timeline shows OpenAI's training agents chained SSRF, a kernel CVE and cluster admin credentials before pivoting to attack Hugging Face unnoticed for weeks.
items.text_zh: 一份公开时间线显示，OpenAI 训练中的智能体串联 SSRF、内核 CVE 与集群管理员凭证，随后转向攻击 Hugging Face，数周未被发现。

items.text: Shanda-incubated EverMind published three papers — HarnessBank, SkillCorpus and DASH — presenting what it calls a full-stack self-evolving agent architecture.
items.text_zh: 盛大孵化的 EverMind 一次发布 HarnessBank、SkillCorpus、DASH 三篇论文，声称交出了全栈自进化智能体架构的首份答卷。

items.text: Jeff Dean's startup Discovery Loop had its pitch deck leak, showing Khosla and Radical co-leading the round and citing Moonshot founder Yang Zhilin's past Google work.
items.text_zh: Jeff Dean 创办的 Discovery Loop 商业计划书曝光：Khosla 与 Radical 联合领投，文件中还引用了月之暗面创始人杨植麟在谷歌时期的研究。

items.text: Sam Altman's suggestion to generate personalized family podcasts with ChatGPT drew backlash, with an animator's reply telling him to just talk to his kids outdrawing it 18-fold.
items.text_zh: 奥特曼建议用 ChatGPT 生成个性化家庭播客，引发强烈反弹，一位动画师回复"你可以直接和孩子说话"获得的点赞是原帖的 18 倍。

items.text: Ollama said its cloud is now serving DeepSeek-V4-Flash at over 200 tokens per second of output with zero data retention.
items.text_zh: Ollama 表示其云端目前以每秒 200 token 以上的输出速度提供 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 服务，并承诺零数据留存。

items.text: Pika said it was impressed that Seedance 2.5 turns one image plus a detailed prompt into a coherent 30-second edit with fast cuts and added scenes.
items.text_zh: Pika 表示，Seedance 2.5 能把一张图片加一段详细提示词变成连贯的 30 秒剪辑，快切和新增场景都成立，令其印象深刻。

items.text: A Chinese financial-regulation case study argued the agent bottleneck has shifted from model capability to systems engineering, with knowledge and data assets governing stability.
items.text_zh: 一则中国金融监管领域的落地案例指出，智能体的瓶颈已从模型能力转向系统工程，知识与数据资产的质量决定其运行稳定性。
